---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

**Example**: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🚀 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## 📊 Use Cases

Describe specific use cases where this feature would be valuable:

1. **Use Case 1**: ...
2. **Use Case 2**: ...
3. **Use Case 3**: ...

## 🎨 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples from other apps.

## 📈 Impact

Who would benefit from this feature?

- [ ] All users
- [ ] Power users
- [ ] Team users
- [ ] Specific use case: ___________

## 🏷️ Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my workflow
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just an idea

## 🔧 Implementation Complexity

Do you have thoughts on implementation difficulty?

- [ ] Simple - UI change or small enhancement
- [ ] Medium - New component or feature
- [ ] Complex - Requires significant architecture changes
- [ ] Unknown

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or references about the feature request here.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched for similar feature requests
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem and solution
- [ ] I have provided use cases
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
